title: Article. The Investment Matching Principle: How the Risk/ Return Profile Connects to Diversification
summary:
This week's memo title is the investment matching principle, how the risk
return profile connects to diversification. Warren Buffett famously issues excessive diversification, but he also focuses
on investments that have very little risk of impairment of capital. A successful investor can be one who diversifies
a lot or a little, but it will always be someone who matches risk of impairment of capital
with the number of independent investments they make.
